import os, re, datetime
infile='/mnt/data/spreadsheet/30709/1_30709_input.xlsx'
outfile='/mnt/data/outputs/30709_0_9ea70f1a/1_30709_output.xlsx'

wb=load_workbook(infile)
ws=wb['Sheet1']

# inspect and extract dates from D6:D19 into E6:E19
date_patterns = [
    # dd.mm.yy or dd/mm/yyyy etc
    (re.compile(r'\b(\d{1,2})[./-](\d{1,2})[./-](\d{2,4})\b'), 'dmy'),
    # yyyy-mm-dd etc
    (re.compile(r'\b(\d{4})[./-](\d{1,2})[./-](\d{1,2})\b'), 'ymd'),
]

for row in range(6, 20):
    text = ws[f'D{row}'].value
    value = None
    if text is not None:
        s = str(text)
        m = None
        kind = None
        # Try ymd first if applicable to avoid interpreting 2024-02-16 as invalid dmy
        for pat, k in [date_patterns[1], date_patterns[0]]:
            m = pat.search(s)
            if m:
                kind = k
                break
        if m:
            if kind == 'dmy':
                day, month, year = map(int, m.groups())
                if year < 100:
                    year += 2000 if year <= 69 else 1900
            else:
                year, month, day = map(int, m.groups())
            try:
                value = datetime.datetime(year, month, day)
            except ValueError:
                value = None
    ws[f'E{row}'] = value
    if value is not None:
        ws[f'E{row}'].number_format = 'yyyy-mm-dd h:mm:ss'

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(outfile), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(outfile)
print(outfile, os.path.exists(outfile))
